site.door.title: Did I lock the back door?
site.door.p1: Did I è la domanda senza risposta per stasera. Una sul piatto. DID se l'hai fatto. Nope se stasera non è quella notte.
site.door.p2: Home dice cosa resta. Stasera è dove premi DID o nope. I tags raggruppano le domande. L'ingranaggio sono le impostazioni.
site.door.p3: Nessun account. Questo browser tiene le tue domande. Hayes Street è un appartamento inventato se vuoi un set completo da provare.
site.name.title: Nomina questo telefono.
site.name.body: Le tue domande restano su questo computer. Niente email e niente password. Prova una demo se vuoi toccare senza scrivere domande prima.
site.name.label: Nome del tag
site.read.title: Come usarlo.
site.read.p1: Home è la facciata. Ti dice cosa resta stasera. Stasera è il tap. Una domanda. DID o nope. Finisci stasera e lo streak sale. Torna domani.
site.read.p2: Una domanda può aspettare fino a un orario. In arrivo mostra le prossime notti così una domanda in attesa non è uno schermo vuoto. L'ultima volta è ieri sera, o l'ultimo giorno dovuto, se l'hai persa. In ritardo conta lo stesso.
site.read.p3: Aggiungi una domanda da Domande, o inizia da Cosa chiedere. Può essere ogni giorno, alcuni giorni, mensile, ogni pochi giorni, o una volta. Il giorno cambia all'ora in Impostazioni, quindi un tap all'1 di notte appartiene ancora a ieri se il cambio è alle 4.
site.read.p4: Questo telefono tiene le tue domande. Niente email. Impostazioni ha una copia del file, un blocco numerico opzionale e promemoria. Chrome e Android possono ping all'ora della domanda. Un iPhone può installare la pagina. I ping lì sono deboli finché un Mac compila l'app nativa.
site.read.p5: y o spazio è DID. s è nope. n aggiunge una domanda. Escape chiude un piatto. u annulla l'ultimo tap per qualche secondo.

import { Tonight, sampleBoard, emptyBoard } from './lib'

legal.privacy.title: Privacy Policy
legal.privacy.intro.title: Who this is for
legal.privacy.intro.body:
Did I ("we", "us") is operated by {operator}. This policy explains what the app collects, why, and what you can do about it.

Questions: {email}{emailNote}.
legal.privacy.local.title: Without an account
legal.privacy.local.body:
You can use Did I on this phone with no sign-in. Your questions, answers, coins, gems, and settings stay in this browser or app unless you turn on an account.

We do not receive that local data unless you choose to sync or share a copy yourself.
legal.privacy.account.title: When you sign in
legal.privacy.account.body:
If you create an account with an email code, we store:

Your email address (for sign-in).

Your display name and handle.

A copy of your shelf (tags, questions, answers, shop progress) in our database so you can sync across phones.

Device rows (a label you choose, platform, last seen time, and a push token if you allow notifications).

Profile preferences such as your equipped look and cheer.
legal.privacy.social.title: Friends, family, and sends
legal.privacy.social.body:
When you use People features we store friendship requests, family memberships and roles, invite codes you create or redeem, Did I sends you make or receive, and block/report records you file.

Other people in a family or on your friends list can see what the app is designed to show them (names, streaks you share, family questions, and similar).
legal.privacy.dit.title: Did I tonight (public list)
legal.privacy.dit.body:
This list is off by default. If you opt in, we store that you are public tonight, up to three short lines from your DID labels for that night, streak counts others can already see, and cheer counts.

Lines can be reported. Two different reporters can remove a line without waiting for a human review. Report rows are kept for moderation.
legal.privacy.push.title: Notifications
legal.privacy.push.body:
On Android, if you allow notifications, we store a push token tied to your account and device. We use it to deliver friend Did I sends, friend requests, and similar nudges. You can turn notifications off in phone settings.

Local reminders for due questions stay on the device and do not need an account.
legal.privacy.pay.title: Gem purchases
legal.privacy.pay.body: If you buy gem packs, Stripe processes payment. We receive your user id, pack id, gem count, and payment status so we can credit your shelf. We do not store your card number. Stripe handles card data under its own privacy policy.
legal.privacy.vendors.title: Service providers
legal.privacy.vendors.body:
We use Supabase (hosting, database, auth), Google Firebase Cloud Messaging (push on Android), and Stripe (web checkout). They process data on our behalf under their terms.

Optional crash reports go only to a URL you configure (VITE_REPORT_URL). We do not run third-party ad trackers in the app.
legal.privacy.use.title: How we use data
legal.privacy.use.body:
We use your data to run the app: sync your shelf, deliver social features, show the public list when you opt in, send pushes you asked for, process purchases, prevent abuse, and fix bugs.

We do not sell your personal information.
legal.privacy.share.title: When we share
legal.privacy.share.body:
We share data with service providers listed above, when you direct us to (for example showing your public lines), when required by law, or to protect safety and rights.

Other users see only what the product shows them (friend names, family boards, public tonight lines, and the like).
legal.privacy.retain.title: How long we keep it
legal.privacy.retain.body:
Local data stays until you clear it or uninstall. Account data stays while your account exists.

Public tonight lines and cheers roll off after about fourteen nights. Push queue rows clear after sending.

When you delete your account we remove your shelf, profile, devices, and auth user through the in-app delete flow.
legal.privacy.rights.title: Your choices and rights
legal.privacy.rights.body:
Export: Settings can download a JSON copy of this phone. Account has Download my data.

Delete: Account can delete this account, which removes cloud data tied to you.

Opt out: Stay signed out, turn off public tonight, block people, sign out devices, or disable notifications.

Depending on where you live you may have rights to access, correct, or delete personal data. Email {email} and we will respond within a reasonable time.
legal.privacy.kids.title: Children
legal.privacy.kids.body:
Did I is a general reminder app, not a children's product. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13. If you believe a child under 13 signed up, email {email} and we will delete the account.

Families can include a kid role for shared chores. A parent should create and supervise kid use.
legal.privacy.security.title: Security
legal.privacy.security.body: We use row-level security, HTTPS, and access controls on the database. No method is perfect. Use a phone lock and do not share your email code.
legal.privacy.intl.title: Where data lives
legal.privacy.intl.body: Data is processed in the United States and where our providers operate. If you use Did I from another country, you consent to that transfer.
legal.privacy.changes.title: Changes
legal.privacy.changes.body: We may update this policy. The effective date at the top will change. Continued use after an update means you accept the revised policy.
legal.privacy.contact.title: Contact
legal.terms.title: Terms of Use
legal.terms.intro.title: Agreement
legal.terms.intro.body: These Terms are between you and {operator}, who operates Did I. By using the app you agree to these Terms and the Privacy Policy. If you do not agree, do not use Did I.
legal.terms.eligible.title: Who may use Did I
legal.terms.eligible.body:
You must be at least 13 years old, or have a parent or guardian's permission. You must be able to form a binding contract where you live.

You are responsible for following local law.
legal.terms.service.title: What Did I is
legal.terms.service.body:
Did I is a personal reminder tool. It helps you track habits and questions you choose. It is not a medical device, emergency service, or professional advice. Do not rely on Did I for medication timing, safety-critical checks, or anything where a missed tap could cause harm.

Use your own judgment. Verify important tasks yourself.
legal.terms.content.title: Your questions and answers
legal.terms.content.body:
You own the content you enter. You grant us a license to store, sync, and display it as the app requires (including public tonight lines you opt into).

You are responsible for what you write. Do not enter illegal content or someone else's private information without permission.
legal.terms.account.title: Accounts
legal.terms.account.body: Sign-in uses a one-time email code. Keep your email access secure. You may sign out one device or everywhere, export data, or delete your account in Account settings.
legal.terms.social.title: People features
legal.terms.social.body:
Friends, families, sends, and invites are optional. You may block someone; blocking removes friendship and pending nudges on our side. You may report users or public lines.

We may suspend accounts that abuse others or the service.
legal.terms.dit.title: Did I tonight
legal.terms.dit.body: The public list is opt in. Lines are short labels from your board, not private notes. Do not post harassing, illegal, or identifying information about others. We may remove lines through reports or at our discretion.
legal.terms.family.title: Families and kid role
legal.terms.family.body: Families share questions among members. Parent and kid roles control who can assign tasks. Did I is not directed at children; parents are responsible for kid accounts they allow on a family.
legal.terms.pay.title: Gem purchases
legal.terms.pay.body:
Gem packs are digital goods for in-app cheers and looks. Prices are shown before checkout. Web purchases go through Stripe. Android may open the web shop until in-app billing is available.

Except where required by law, gem purchases are final once delivered to your shelf. Chargebacks for valid purchases may lead to account suspension.
legal.terms.rules.title: Rules
legal.terms.rules.body:
Do not: break the law, harass others, spam invites or sends, attempt to hack the service, scrape other users, impersonate others, or use bots to abuse caps.

Do not reverse engineer the service to bypass paywalls or limits.
legal.terms.end.title: Ending use
legal.terms.end.body: You may stop using Did I anytime and delete your account. We may suspend or terminate access if you break these Terms or harm others. Sections that should survive (disclaimers, limits, disputes) survive termination.
legal.terms.warranty.title: No warranty
legal.terms.warranty.body: Did I is provided "as is" and "as available" without warranties of any kind, express or implied, including fitness for a particular purpose, accuracy, or non-infringement.
legal.terms.liability.title: Limit of liability

To the fullest extent allowed by law, {operator} is not liable for indirect, incidental, special, consequential, or punitive damages, or for lost data, missed reminders, or harm from relying on the app.

Our total liability for any claim is limited to the greater of fifty US dollars or the amount you paid us in the twelve months before the claim.

Disputes should first be emailed to {email}. If we cannot resolve a dispute, courts in that state have exclusive jurisdiction, unless your local consumer law requires otherwise.
